$comment: Wave V4 of docs/COMPONENT-VARIANTS-PLAN.md: banking widgets. Per component, its variants (the class bx-<kind>--<id> on its root and the variant property in every pack; the default needs no class), its motion and its empty and loading states, and per pack whether each variant is built. Merged into variants.json.

leftToOtherWaves.number: V5 (rolling-digits, count-up and scrub-field are effects)

variants.name: Circle
variants.purpose: A round photo or the initials on a neutral fill; the default.

variants.name: Rounded
variants.purpose: A rounded square, for businesses and payees that are companies.

variants.name: Ring
variants.purpose: A circle with a brand ring around it, for the signed-in customer.

variants.name: Tonal
variants.purpose: Initials on a soft colour picked from the name, so payees tell apart at a glance.

motion.enter: Fades in
motion.hover: None: an avatar is not a control
motion.press: None
motion.change: A new photo cross-fades over the initials
motion.reduced: Changes at once

states.empty: No photo: the initials of the name; no name: an empty circle with no label
states.loading: None: the initials show until the photo loads

variants.name: List
variants.purpose: Rows with a line between and the action on the right; the default.

variants.name: Compact
variants.purpose: One line a row with the meta beside the title, for dashboards with little room.

variants.name: Detailed
variants.purpose: Taller rows: the meta on its own line and the value set large, for a page of its own.
variants.pattern: Inset grouped list (Apple Human Interface Guidelines)

variants.name: Card
variants.purpose: Each row its own card with space between, for a feed the customer scrolls.

variants.name: Glass
variants.purpose: The panel as glass over a backdrop or photo, for a home screen.
variants.pattern: Liquid glass: a translucent fill with a lit rim over the page (the pack's glass.json); solid where the user asks for less transparency

motion.enter: Rows settle in from 8 px below, 30 ms apart (--bx-dur-base, --bx-ease-standard)
motion.hover: The row takes the surface tint; the action underlines
motion.press: The row or its action scales to 0.98 and back
motion.change: A new row fades in at its place; a removed row fades out and the rest close up
motion.reduced: No movement: rows appear at once and only colours change

states.empty: "Nothing here yet." (the emptyText line, said by screen readers)
states.loading: Three skeleton rows under the heading; role status "Loading" with aria-busy, set by the loading property

variants.name: Card

variants.name: Compact
variants.purpose: Label and amount on one line, for a header or a list of accounts.

variants.name: Hero
variants.purpose: The amount large on the brand colour, for the top of the home screen.

variants.name: Glass

motion.enter: The card fades and rises 8 px (--bx-dur-base)
motion.hover: None on the card; the Show or Hide button takes the surface tint
motion.press: The Show or Hide button scales to 0.97
motion.change: Hiding or showing cross-fades the amount; a new amount rolls its digits (the number effects of wave V5)
motion.reduced: The amount changes at once with no fade or roll

states.empty: No amount: the amount line is left empty and the label stays
states.loading: A skeleton line in place of the amount; role status "Loading" with aria-busy, set by the loading property

variants.name: Classic
variants.purpose: Dark tiles with light characters, like a departures board; the default.

variants.name: Light
variants.purpose: Light tiles on the surface, for a light page.

variants.name: Compact
variants.purpose: Smaller tiles in one tight column, for a widget.

motion.enter: Each tile flips from blank to its character, left to right
motion.hover: None
motion.press: None
motion.change: Changed tiles flip to their new character
motion.reduced: Characters change at once with no flip

states.empty: No rows: the heading only
states.loading: None: the screen gives the rates

variants.name: Dots
variants.purpose: The number masked to its last four digits, with Show; the default.

variants.name: Blur
variants.purpose: The masked digits are blurred until shown, so a glance over the shoulder sees nothing; the real number is never in the page while hidden.

variants.name: Card
variants.purpose: The number in its own card with a large mono face and the label above.

motion.enter: Fades in
motion.hover: Show takes the surface tint
motion.press: Show scales to 0.97
motion.change: Revealing flips each digit in turn
motion.reduced: The number changes at once

states.empty: No number: the field shows nothing to reveal and Show stays
states.loading: None: the screen gives the number

variants.name: Card
variants.purpose: The tick, the amount, the reference and the details in a card; the default.

variants.name: Ticket
variants.purpose: A paper receipt with a perforated edge and a dashed line before the details.

variants.name: Minimal
variants.purpose: No card: the amount and details straight on the page, for a full screen.

variants.name: Glass
variants.purpose: The receipt as glass over a backdrop, for a success screen with a gradient.
variants.pattern: Liquid glass: a translucent fill with a lit rim over the page (the pack's glass.json); solid where the user asks for less transparency

motion.enter: The tick pops (bx-pop) and the card rises 8 px; the details follow 60 ms later
motion.hover: None on the card; the actions take their button hover
motion.press: The actions scale to 0.97
motion.change: None: a receipt does not change once shown
motion.reduced: Everything shows at once with no pop or rise

states.empty: No details: the tick, the heading and the reference only
states.loading: None: the screen shows the receipt when the bank has confirmed

variants.name: Pill
variants.purpose: A rounded field with a spark and Ask, suggestions above; the default.

variants.name: Boxed
variants.purpose: A square-cornered box with the suggestions inside it, for a page.

variants.name: Glass
variants.purpose: The bar as glass floating over the page.
variants.pattern: Liquid glass: a translucent fill with a lit rim over the page (the pack's glass.json); solid where the user asks for less transparency

motion.enter: The bar rises 8 px; the suggestions follow 30 ms apart
motion.hover: Suggestions take the surface tint
motion.press: Suggestions and Ask scale to 0.97
motion.change: Busy pulses the spark
motion.reduced: No rise or pulse; busy is said by the button

states.empty: No suggestions: the field alone
states.loading: Busy: Ask is disabled and busy (aria-busy), set by the busy property
